title: Summary
text: This session bootstrapped AgentWiki from scratch — a project memory compiler for AI-assisted software development. Agents emit rich HTML reports and AgentWiki compiles them into a searchable, graph-connected website. Core design decision: HTML-first reports as the canonical agent output format. Each report is a report.html + manifest.json + chunks.jsonl triplet. Three phases completed: repo skeleton with JSON schemas (Phase 0), full compiler pipeline producing KnowledgeNode JSON (Phase 1), and Astro 5 static website (Phase 2). Workspace rules and /report global command also established.

title: Changes Made
text: pyproject.toml: uv project init, entry point agentwiki, build-system declared. compiler/models.py: KnowledgeNode, Edge, Section, Entity TypedDicts. compiler/compiler.py: full pipeline parse, resolve backlinks, emit dist/. compiler/cli.py: compile and dev Click commands. compiler/parser/html_report.py: parses report.html and manifest.json. compiler/parser/markdown_doc.py: parses .md files with H2-level sections. schema/manifest.schema.json and schema/node.schema.json: JSON Schemas. samples/: synthetic report and doc fixtures. site/: Astro 5 site with Base layout, NodeCard, index page, node detail page. CLAUDE.md: workspace and project rules. ~/.claude/commands/report.md: global /report command.

title: Key Symbols
text: compiler/compiler.py::compile_inputs(), resolve_backlinks(), emit(). compiler/models.py::KnowledgeNode TypedDict. compiler/cli.py::compile and dev commands. site/src/lib/data.ts::getIndex(), getNode(), idToSlug(). site/src/pages/nodes/[id].astro: node detail page. site/src/pages/index.astro: homepage with node cards.

title: Evidence
text: CLI: uv run agentwiki compile produces 3 nodes (report:retrieval-refactor-001 with 5 sections and 5 links, doc:architecture with 4 sections, doc:overview with 4 sections). Site at localhost:4321 renders homepage with node cards grouped by type and detail pages with section cards, entity pills, and typed links. Reliability fix: added build-system to pyproject.toml to ensure uv sync always produces editable install.

title: Open Questions
text: Phase 3 search: Pagefind keyword only or hybrid with LanceDB vector? Should /report auto-run uv run agentwiki compile after writing files? Git identity is auto-configured from hostname — set user.name and user.email globally?
